name: alladin_status
description: Read the Solana spot paper portfolio, latest decision, open positions and circuit breakers from GET /v1/status.

name: alladin_performance
description: Read net closed-trade statistics, uncertainty, sample adequacy and the 900-entry research target from GET /v1/performance. It does not guarantee returns.

name: alladin_command
description: Call the authenticated Alladin backend. It only supports Coinbase-only SOL-USDC spot paper cycles and public market collection. It never connects a wallet, signs, or sends a transaction. Supply a unique idempotency key per logical request.

args.description: Arguments exactly matching GET /v1/contract; use an empty object for commands with no arguments.
